verdicts.evidence: The logbook only performs an analytic check of the aggregation equations (Eq. 4-9); it never implements or runs ConfSleepNet's multi-view evidence extraction from EEG/EOG or the CMAM in a sleep-staging pipeline. No code or model was built.

Explicitly marked BLOCKED and not attempted: the upstream repo is README-only and SleepEDF data was still downloading. No evidence about the 5-class/3-class hybrid category structures or the evidence-mapping layer with matrix U was produced.
Explicitly marked BLOCKED: no training runs on SleepEDF-20/78, MASS-SS3, or SHHS were executed. No accuracy numbers of any kind were produced.
No ablation experiments were run. The logbook does not address the MASS-SS3 ablation comparison (ConfSleepNet vs. average-fusion Case I) at all.

A numpy script (verify_prop.py) transcribed Eq. 4-9 and checked the propositions analytically: Proposition 1 (C→0) holds, but Proposition 2 (C→1) fails under Eq. 8 as printed (the limit yields u_a·u_b/(u_a+u_b) < u_o, a decrease) and only holds under a normalization-consistent formula u=1−Σb. This is a real but simplified isolated-equation check with mixed results, neither a full verification nor a full refutation of the claim that both propositions are proven.

overall: The logbook only addresses Claim 5 via a lightweight analytic check of the aggregation equations, finding that Proposition 1 holds but Proposition 2 fails with Eq. 8 as printed (only holding under a normalization correction). All four empirical claims (1-4) are unaddressed because no ConfSleepNet code was implemented and no datasets were trained on.
